# platforms

The second argument of `host()`, and `isActive` checks inside features.

## platforms.nixos()

NixOS, applied with nixos-rebuild.

```ts
platforms.nixos(opts?: NixosPlatformOpts): PlatformLazyFragment
```

**`opts`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `system?` | `string` | The Nix system, e.g. "aarch64-linux". Defaults to "x86_64-linux". |
| `stateVersion?` | `string` | `system.stateVersion`: the NixOS release this machine was first installed with (not the latest). |
| `allowUnfree?` | `boolean` | Allow unfree packages. Defaults to true. |
| `homeManager?` | `boolean` | Include Home Manager (as a NixOS module, with `useGlobalPkgs` and `useUserPackages`). Defaults to true. |
| `hostname?` | `string \| false` | `networking.hostName`. Defaults to the host's name; false leaves it unset. |

### platforms.nixos.isActive

```ts
platforms.nixos.isActive: boolean
```

True while building a host on this platform (inside a feature or host body).

### platforms.nixos.id

```ts
platforms.nixos.id: string
```

The platform's id: "nixos" (also for WSL), "darwin" or "windows".

## platforms.wsl()

NixOS running under WSL: imports the NixOS-WSL module and enables it.
The host is still a NixOS host, so `platforms.nixos.isActive` is also
true; `platforms.wsl.isActive` is true only for WSL hosts.

```ts
platforms.wsl(opts?: WslPlatformOpts): PlatformLazyFragment
```

**`opts`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `input?` | `string` | Nix input name providing NixOS-WSL, as it appears in `inputs.<name>`. Defaults to "nixos-wsl" (the kebab-case name of a `nixosWsl` input). |
| `system?` | `string` | The Nix system, e.g. "aarch64-linux". Defaults to "x86_64-linux". |
| `stateVersion?` | `string` | `system.stateVersion`: the NixOS release this machine was first installed with (not the latest). |
| `allowUnfree?` | `boolean` | Allow unfree packages. Defaults to true. |
| `homeManager?` | `boolean` | Include Home Manager (as a NixOS module, with `useGlobalPkgs` and `useUserPackages`). Defaults to true. |
| `hostname?` | `string \| false` | `networking.hostName`. Defaults to the host's name; false leaves it unset. |

### platforms.wsl.isActive

```ts
platforms.wsl.isActive: boolean
```

True while building a host on this platform (inside a feature or host body).

### platforms.wsl.id

```ts
platforms.wsl.id: string
```

The platform's id: "nixos" (also for WSL), "darwin" or "windows".

## platforms.darwin()

macOS with nix-darwin, applied with darwin-rebuild.

```ts
platforms.darwin(opts?: DarwinPlatformOpts): PlatformLazyFragment
```

**`opts`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `system?` | `string` | The Nix system. Defaults to "aarch64-darwin". |
| `stateVersion?` | `string \| number` | nix-darwin's `system.stateVersion`. |
| `allowUnfree?` | `boolean` | Allow unfree packages. Defaults to true. |
| `homeManager?` | `boolean` | Include Home Manager (as a nix-darwin module). Defaults to true. |
| `homebrew?` | `boolean` | Manage Homebrew through nix-homebrew (needs a nix-homebrew input). Defaults to false. |
| `hostname?` | `string \| false` | `networking.hostName`. Defaults to the host's name; false leaves it unset. |

### platforms.darwin.isActive

```ts
platforms.darwin.isActive: boolean
```

True while building a host on this platform (inside a feature or host body).

### platforms.darwin.id

```ts
platforms.darwin.id: string
```

The platform's id: "nixos" (also for WSL), "darwin" or "windows".

## platforms.windows()

Windows, applied by Winix itself (WinGet, PowerShell, DSC).

```ts
platforms.windows(opts?: WindowsPlatformOpts): PlatformLazyFragment
```

**`opts`**

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hostname?` | `string \| false` | Hostname override; falls back to the host name from eval context. |

### platforms.windows.isActive

```ts
platforms.windows.isActive: boolean
```

True while building a host on this platform (inside a feature or host body).

### platforms.windows.id

```ts
platforms.windows.id: string
```

The platform's id: "nixos" (also for WSL), "darwin" or "windows".
